instruction: Extract the video frame at 00:12 and apply it as the background image for the fifth slide of the presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting a frame from landscape.mp4 at 00:12 and setting it as the background of slide 5 (index 4). Evaluator extracts the background image from the slide, then programmatically extracts the expected frame from landscape.mp4 at 00:12 timestamp using ffmpeg, and compares the two images using perceptual hashing and pixel similarity. Full credit given only when the background image matches the expected video frame at 00:12.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all task requirements: (1) background on slide 5, (2) frame from landscape.mp4, (3) frame at 00:12 timestamp
Getter properly extracts background image from slide XML structure (impress.py:52-112)
Getter uses ffmpeg to extract expected frame from landscape.mp4 at exactly 00:12 timestamp (impress.py:114-146, line 130: '-ss', '00:00:12')
Image comparison uses robust dual-method approach: perceptual hashing + pixel similarity with 95% threshold (impress.py:168-224)
Metric correctly checks images_match to verify background matches expected frame, giving full credit (1.0) only when they match (metrics/impress.py:44-53)
No false positives: Won't pass if wrong video, wrong timestamp, random 16:9 image, or pre-existing background
Complete coverage: All instruction requirements semantically verified
Postconfig appropriately saves PPT file to ensure background is persisted before evaluation (evaluator.postconfig lines 51-80)
